intro.title: TanStack Query Basics
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple Vue application that fetches and displays a list of posts from a mock API. You will learn the core concept of server-state management using TanStack Query (Vue Query) to handle data fetching, caching, and synchronization. The main technologies involved are Vue 3 with the Composition API, the TanStack Query Vue library, and JavaScript for logic. By the end, you'll understand how to efficiently load and update remote data in your Vue apps without manual state management.
intro.usecase: TanStack Query is essential for building data-driven Vue applications like e-commerce dashboards that display real-time sales metrics, inventory levels, and customer analytics. Developers use it in social media feeds to efficiently fetch, cache, and update posts, comments, and notifications without manual state management. It's also crucial for admin panels that manage user data, where paginated tables, filters, and search functionality require optimized server-state synchronization. This pattern eliminates repetitive loading/error logic, letting you focus on building responsive UIs that feel instant to users.
